change_summary: Structural policy improvement: add delayed_low_receive mode to suppress early grounded jumps on fast low built-in returns.
failure_analysis: Generation-3 built-in traces showed repeated point losses where the policy jumped while grounded at ball_y around 0.40 to 0.48 and was airborne when the ball reached floor height.
next_hypothesis: Keep only if built-in dev score improves without unacceptable regression against archived opponent pool; otherwise roll back and record the failed branch.

change_summary: Rolled back delayed_low_receive after generation-3 dev evidence worsened built-in score; kept the failure note and append-only failed trial.
failure_analysis: The delayed low receive branch suppressed useful contacts: built-in mean worsened from -4.24 to -4.72 on dev seeds 6000..6049, so the branch was removed.
next_hypothesis: A simple early-jump suppression band is too blunt; future work should use a phase-aware receive macro or stronger context before changing jump timing.

change_summary: Structural policy improvement: add rally_restart_serve state detector so serve behavior can run after each point reset, not only the first episode steps.
failure_analysis: Trace diagnosis showed SlimeVolley restarts at ball_y around 1.2 while the old serve gate required ball_y >= 1.45 and was also tied to episode steps; serve mode was effectively inert.
next_hypothesis: If built-in dev score improves, run archived-opponent tournament to check robustness; if it worsens, roll back and keep failure evidence.

change_summary: Structural policy revision: make rally_restart_serve phase-aware by approaching the serve target before jumping, after immediate restart jumps worsened dev score.
failure_analysis: Immediate state-based restart jumps worsened built-in mean from -4.24 to -4.32; this revision separates approach and hit phases using x-position.
next_hypothesis: Keep only if built-in dev score beats or matches the rollback baseline and archived-opponent robustness does not regress.

change_summary: Rolled back rally_restart_serve after both immediate-jump and approach-then-hit versions underperformed the generation-3 dev baseline.
failure_analysis: Restart serve detector was a valid code-smell hypothesis, but immediate jump mean -4.32 and approach-then-hit mean -4.26 both trailed the rollback baseline -4.24 on dev seeds 6000..6049.
next_hypothesis: Do not change restart serve without deeper point-level trajectory evidence; next structural work should target return placement or contact outcome after actual ball contact.

change_summary: Structural policy improvement: add rear_wall_press mode for low descending balls outside the rear guard, based on contact diagnostics showing rear-wall candidates dominate built-in losses.
failure_analysis: Contact diagnostics found rear-wall inferred contacts in 145/270 candidates and low_far_right was the largest loss bucket; current clipping to rear_guard_x can leave the policy at action 000 while the ball remains outside the guard.
next_hypothesis: Keep only if built-in development score improves and then check archived-opponent robustness; otherwise roll back and record the failed contact-placement attempt.
